name: DeepFact-Bench
description: A versioned factuality benchmark for evaluating AI systems performing deep research report generation. Tasks require verifying complex, multi-step research claims drawn from long-form AI-generated documents. Introduces an Audit-then-Score (AtS) dispute resolution process to iteratively refine benchmark labels, improving expert annotation agreement from 60.8% to 90.9% across four rounds.
evaluation_method: factuality score via Audit-then-Score (AtS) pipeline with human dispute resolution
typical_sota_score: Not yet established; benchmark published March 2026
reputation: Newly published (March 2026); addresses the gap in factuality evaluation for deep research reports generated by LLM agents; co-evolving benchmark and agent design is novel
notes: Co-evolving benchmark design means labels can change as the benchmark and agents mutually improve. Targets deep research reports (DRRs) rather than factoid QA, filling a gap not covered by existing fact-checkers. Versioned with auditable rationales. Paper: arXiv 2603.05912.
